{{Quote|And to do that, we must go to the lower levels. The underworld.|[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]|<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref>}}
'''Underworld portals''' led into the heart of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A massive ventilation shaft and shipping portal, it allowed for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to enter and exit the extensive undercity of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Description==
Besides serving as a shipping portal with access into the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], the ventilation shaft collected numerous sewage shafts from nearby buildings on the surface. One of those pipeline networks originated at the [[Republic military base]].
